data.title: Review and own the connected office twin PR

evidence: “The dashboard-only review is in the findings panel: 10 findings, 9 still open and 1 fixed.”

data.text: Create a ticket only when the user asks the agent for something needed or something to be fixed. Ordinary chat messages must not automatically create tickets.
data.rationale: The user explicitly distinguished actionable needs and repairs from general conversation.

evidence: “a ticket is only for when you ask an agent that we need something or need to fix something, so a ticket shouldnt automatically be created when you write something to it”
